storage: Airtight container in a cool, dry place for about a month once opened (general guidance), or the fridge in humid weather to keep them crisp.
looksLike: Small tan to light-brown oval kernels, usually skinned (red skin rubbed off), crunchy and nutty. Sold plain (unsalted) or salted; this entry is the plain kind.
howToPick: Buy crisp, evenly tan kernels with a clean roasted smell. Avoid nuts that smell rancid, taste bitter or stale, or have dark, mouldy or shrivelled kernels.
shelfLife: About 3 to 6 months sealed per typical pack labels (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run); oils go rancid with time and heat.
substitutes: Raw peanuts, dry-roasted at home in a pan (2 to 3 min)
Roasted chana or roasted gram dal (dish 83 low-oil variant adds 10 g roasted chana)

usedIn.raw: 8 g per serving (1 tbsp); 5 g in the Gluten-free variant (replacing papdi)
